messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +7.5%, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.41 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.43 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your detailed review of the figures and your proposal for a 24-month agreement. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.47 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

As an alternative, we can support a 24-month contract at €5.52 per unit with 30 days payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer fixed prices for this extended duration. This option provides a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your reply and for the steps you have made - we appreciate it.

We are close now; the options below are a fair way to close the remaining gap.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.52 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.39 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.47 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

Which base month and deadband would you consider fair for an index clause?

We would be glad to finalise on this basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As a trusted partner, we always strive to support your business with our extensive material range and top-tier service. Our current main Angebot stands at a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We consider a 0% deadband with the base month of August 2026 to be the most fair and transparent approach, as it directly aligns with actual material costs. Building on your requested 24-month agreement and 90 days payment terms, we can adjust our offer to €5.44 per unit. This price represents a significant concession on our part to close the remaining gap and finalize our agreement.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.44 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note this proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
